prompts.name: ocean-grand-islet-v01
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original Aurevane high-detail grand offshore landmark sprite for an isometric fantasy world map. Create ONE large magnificent rocky forest islet with an enormous natural sea arch, stacked weathered sea cliffs, a compact grove of beautifully shaped windswept pines, a little crescent pebble beach and an irregular apron of very detailed turquoise reef shelves, submerged stones, dark blue channels, transparent shallows and restrained white shore foam. This is one coherent natural offshore composition, NOT a sheet and not multiple separate islands. Painterly premium mature fantasy art, crisp tactile stone, individual foliage, clear luminous water with physically believable depth and currents. Consistent isometric orthographic camera from southeast, upper-left daylight, original elegant landform design without copied landmarks. The arch and green cliffs form a bold grand silhouette while the ocean remains broad and readable. Use a wide1536×1024 finished canvas and retain fine source detail for normal map zoom. Keep every pine, arch peak, wave and reef inside the frame with at least10% TRANSPARENT margin on all sides. NO square/diamond floor plinth, labels, text, watermark, boats, characters, buildings, tropical resort or hidden lore. Actual transparent background outside the organically feathered water/foam apron; no colored backdrop or haze. Grounded sea-cliff roots and rock-to-water contact, no floating rock. The whole illustrative composition must feel much larger and richer than an ordinary one-tile rock; it does not imply a traversable destination.

prompts.name: valley-fire-detail-v01
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. This is a technical HIGH RESOLUTION DETAIL pass of the supplied Owner-selected Aurevane artwork, NOT a redesign or variant. Preserve the exact original figure identity, face, expression, pose, costume construction, silhouette, proportions, stone materials, color accents, isometric camera, hand gesture and lighting. Do not make it more muscular, feminine, robed, armored, spiky or stylized. No added anatomy, jewelry, emblems, halo, icicle growth or costume. Repaint only finer truthful stone chisel grain, cracks and material edges while retaining the original design. Genuine transparent background. Isolate ONLY the LEFT STANDING FIRE STONE AVATAR from the input, from full flame-shaped mantle and lionlike swept-back stone hair to both bare stone feet. Keep the exact restrained original face looking upward/right and the exact extended open right palm. Its original cloak consists of rugged overlapping flame-shaped stone plates with restrained orange glowing seams, not fabric robes, and its original body has no exposed muscular torso. Remove the gorge, water, trees, stairs, pedestal rocks and other avatar. Preserve its entire silhouette, including the extended hand, without cutting any point. Render one isolated figure as large as possible in a high-resolution1536×2048 portrait canvas with generous8% transparent margin, suitable to overlay the exact same original figure at increased map zoom. Keep the same front three-quarter pose and original camera angle; no turntable or portrait close-up.

prompts.name: valley-cascade-detail-v01
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Technical high-resolution detail enhancement of the EXACT CENTRAL WATERFALL GORGE in the supplied Owner-selected Aurevane scene. Isolate ONLY the central tiered waterfall and its closely adjacent cliff shoulders, maintaining exactly the original main upper fall, central split tier, lower broad falling-water fan, terraced wet cliff silhouettes and direction of water flow. Remove both fire and ice stone figures and remove their staircases. Do not introduce new buildings, figures, columns, mountains or different rock arrangement. Preserve the original cool gray rocks, green moss/trees and clear blue-white water, mature painterly material style, original lighting and isometric camera; improve only fine wet rock, individual water strands, mist and stone detail so it can overlay the same original central gorge at close map zoom. Bottom edge ends in the original foaming plunge pool, with a naturally feathered transparent spray edge, not a rectangular landscape patch. Fully transparent outside the waterfall-and-cliff cutout. ONE coherent gorge detail cutout, not a sprite sheet. High-resolution1536×1536 canvas, entire fall top and plunge fan visible, at least8% transparent margin on all four sides, no text or watermark. Match rather than redesign the source composition.
